  Effective timing
    Startup gives the container 2m30s to come up before the kubelet restarts it.
    Readiness acts after 3 consecutive failures, at worst 1m30s after the container stops responding. Readiness begins after the startup probe succeeds.
    Liveness acts after 3 consecutive failures, at worst 30s after the container stops responding. Liveness begins after the startup probe succeeds. Liveness waits 10s before its first check.

  Findings
    liveness-faster-than-readiness  Liveness detects failure in 30s and readiness in 1m30s, so a failing container is restarted before it is taken out of service.
    timeout-at-default              The startup probe allows the default 1s for an answer, so a container that is only slow to answer counts as failing.
